workspace.storage: caller-owned empty Read + Write + Seek scratch file; contains private witness values
workspace.allocation: best-fit free extents; adjacent regions coalesce; RAII releases failed and dropped temporaries; physical high-water size is not truncated
workspace.fft_schedule: transform first operand, store its evaluations and release its array; transform second operand, multiply by streamed first evaluations, inverse-transform the same array
workspace.division: ascending recurrence for X^d-beta with at most min(d, quotient_length) resident fields and validation of every remaining high coefficient; beta=0 checks low coefficients directly

lower_bound_exclusions: prover workspace authentication indexes and extent metadata
full_fixture_capacity.largest_fft_stage_basis: retained relation/witness/SRS/key plus one 4*n native-Fr transform array and its bounded roots cache; not a measured full-fixture peak
full_fixture_capacity.witness_lowering_basis: retained relation/witness/SRS/key plus three n-field wire columns and one Option<Fr> for each census auxiliary wire

benchmark.fixture: unchanged synthetic multiplication constraints; public test tau 29; nonzero wire and Z blinding
benchmark.srs_backend: authenticated uncompressed file SRS for every sample
benchmark.key_backend: authenticated file key for every sample
benchmark.metric: requested live heap allocations; excludes allocator overhead, transient reallocation internals, stack, RSS and filesystem cache
benchmark.proving_scope: all retained relation, original witness, key and SRS allocations plus proving workspace
benchmark.preprocessing_scope: initial live relation, witness, SRS and arithmetization plus preprocessing; excludes SRS creation/import and relation construction
benchmark.timings: single sequential final runs on a shared host; background load and filesystem cache were not controlled

coverage: FFT comparison with arkworks through multiple roots tiles
exact polynomial identities and packing across storage chunks
division including beta=0, short and long quotients, mutated remainders and chunk boundaries
permutation equality at every row, zero denominators and non-closing products
memory/file workspace proof equality with zero and nonzero blinding
real file SRS/key/workspace proving with both SRS encodings
nonempty storage, short I/O, allocation overflow, failed generation after a written chunk, write/read/flush/seek errors, truncation and poisoned locks
corrupt and failing reads during first, middle and final workspace reads of complete proofs
scratch-region reuse preserves live polynomials and physical file high-water size
bounded nonzero-length scans and cached logical lengths
capacity arithmetic for the complete fixture
